nl_query: 查询租户客户端证书过期时间戳平均值最高的那个 node_id 在表 security_certificate_expiration_client_tenant 中的所有最近7天数据
initial_sql: WITH recent_data AS ( SELECT * FROM cockroach_metrics.security_certificate_expiration_client_tenant WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ), avg_values AS ( SELECT node_id, AVG(greptime_value) AS avg_value FROM recent_data GROUP BY node_id ) SELECT rd.* FROM recent_data rd JOIN (SELECT node_id FROM avg_values ORDER BY avg_value DESC LIMIT 1) AS highest_avg ON rd.node_id = highest_avg.node_id;
